name: Pink Ball Pit
description: A deep bed of candy-pink tennis balls, felt and seams catching soft light.
lighting: Soft even top light, gentle rosy shadows
subject: either
prompt: A deep bed of tennis balls, every one dyed the same candy pink, fills the frame edge to edge, all the same regulation size, their felt fuzz catching a soft top light and their white seams curling in every direction, one continuous two-lobed seam on each ball. The balls pile loose and deep, with a slight hollow at the centre where they have settled. The shadows between them are soft and rosy. The palette is candy pink and white, soft, sporty and sweet.
